Shooting heatmap

tagr_heatmap.Rd

Plots shot x/y coordinates on a fixed half korfball pitch background. Points are coloured by one of: result, type, pressure, leg.

Usage

tagr_heatmap(
  df,
  colour_by = c("result", "type", "pressure", "leg"),
  filter = list(),
  player = NULL
)

Arguments

df

A TeamTV shots data.frame.

colour_by

What to colour points by. One of "result", "type", "pressure", "leg".

filter

Optional named list of filters. Example: list(result = "goal", pressure = "HIGH"). Note: if you supply a filter for the same variable as colour_by, it is ignored.

player

Optional. One or more player identifiers (numbers and/or names). Examples: "11", c("11","24"), "Jane Doe", c("Jane Doe","24").

Value

A ggplot object.
